notes: Businesses: a company is its name plus its location, so two shops with the same name in different cities both fit. The owner gives a first and last name
My Businesses in Settings: switch between your companies, add another, join one with an ID, verify yours with your work email and website, or delete one (type its name)
Each business keeps its own chats, Psyche, team and Ideas
Ervo for Business starts by learning the company: what it does, customers, products, hours, policies, tools, team
Hold your own message for Copy, Send again or Edit
Ervo turns down harmful or illegal requests in one calm line and never shares another company's information
Connected Apps is its own page, out of Ervo Stats; Settings lost the Greeting and Weather rows
The greeting is just "Hi Erick, what can I help you with today?"; tell Ervo "call me …" to change the name
Android: when you close Ervo, one short weather line (temperature and sky), with a brief caution only for storms, snow, rain, very hot, very cold or strong wind; at most every 3 hours, never at night
Ervo Stats: the Back button works again and the page moves smoothly; the sky animates on the graphics chip instead of repainting the screen
Switching between Personal and Business is one smooth transition, with no flash in between
Switching between Personal and Business shows the look you picked for that Ervo, with no flash of the default owl
highlights: Run more than one business and switch between them
Companies are set apart by name and location, with optional verification
Hold any message to copy it
